claims.subject: Execution provider
claims.claim: Job bound to exact provider realization identity
claims.limitation: Does not prove provider/domain semantic correctness.

claims.subject: Executable path
claims.claim: Runtime witnessed target executable path continuity through execution step
claims.limitation: Not target private mount namespace isolation or proof of byte consumption.

claims.subject: Host Dependency
claims.claim: Declared host prerequisite did not drift in witnessed namespace during Attempt
claims.limitation: Partial explicit dependency set; not automatic environment closure.

claims.subject: Immutable input
claims.claim: Committed Job consumed Runtime-owned materialization identity

claims.subject: Credential
claims.claim: Authorized principal selected opaque credential version and Runtime delivered encrypted snapshot via systemd credentials
claims.limitation: Does not prove provider permission or external effect success.

claims.subject: Attempt terminal state
claims.claim: Physical owner reached observed terminal state
claims.witness: Runner/Windows supervisor result + terminal evidence artifact
claims.limitation: Mechanical completion only; semanticCompletionEvaluated remains false.

claims.subject: Artifact
claims.claim: Bytes belong to exact Runtime Artifact identity
claims.limitation: Artifact existence does not imply scientific/business correctness.

claims.subject: Runtime release
claims.limitation: Generic process exit/transport status is subordinate to receipt truth.

claims.subject: Windows physical ownership
claims.claim: Native process tree owned by Windows Job Object/launcher contract
claims.limitation: Does not make Linux and Windows mechanism-equivalent.

migrationRule: Introduce as internal projection first; historical serialized evidence remains readable and need not be rewritten.
